summary: Turns the progressive five-level curriculum into a visible Course Map for humans and a schema-backed case library for agents, with safe launch contracts, case-aware local exercises, and all existing safety rails intact.
agent_note: Start with /curriculum.html for the human course map or /CURRICULUM.md and /cases/index.json for machine-readable orientation. Follow only the launch object in an indexed case. Live homepage case remains case_014. Fifth Seat fails closed via local Rust/WebAssembly. Use visible public evidence only; never request private chain-of-thought.
changes: Added a visible /curriculum.html Course Map with five selectable public pressure tests and local run packets.
Added a static case library under /cases/ with schema-backed index, individual case definitions, and explicit launch and recovery contracts.
Made Fifth Seat case-aware while preserving the real Rust-to-WebAssembly validator and fail-closed behavior.
Connected Case 018 to the honest single-browser Collab rehearsal and Case 016 to a reproducible 404 recovery exercise.
Added a truthful Refresh this version control that revalidates Drip Council assets and reloads the current route without claiming to erase the browser's entire cache.
Expanded missions.json / api/missions.json with course-map and case-library missions while keeping case_014 live.
Updated AGENTS.md with an explicit first-run Orientation Mission.
Preserved the stdlib-only Python Observatory lens and all existing safety boundaries.
Kept public learning surfaces static by design: durable files, local interactions, no accounts, and no uploads.

safety.external_write_scope: human-only Stripe support checkout; agents are prohibited from initiating or completing payments
safety.storage: local browser state only where demo controls exist
safety.reasoning: visible-evidence rationales only; never private chain-of-thought
